acceptance_predicates.description: Selected/all recording scope is explicit and covers exactly the admitted agent/workload set.
Capture, replay, and comparison carry provider/model/agent/workload/run/generation identity and digests.
Strict offline replay succeeds with network denied and never calls the provider.
Incomplete, stale, mismatched, or unavailable artifacts produce typed fail-closed diagnostics.
State and receipts contain digest-bound metadata only, never secrets or raw responses.

definition_of_done: Selected/all capture and offline comparison matrix passes.
Versioned TUI-consumable handoff and human/JSON output are verified.
Independent review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Explicit live benchmark run identity and bounded outcomes.
Selected/all agent and workload capture selection.
